//include: This dir IS the `mote` package (setup.py maps package_dir={mote: .}).
//extraPaths: '..' lets pyright resolve `mote.*` self-imports via the parent dir (the checkout dir is named `mote`, matching the package).
//pythonVersion: Tracks the actual dev/runtime env (3.11), not the >=3.9 floor in setup.py; 3.9 surfaces ~93 extra 3.10+ syntax errors -- revisit when the 3.9-support question is settled.
//optional-deps: Not installed on purpose; ignore their missing imports. manager.py guards the optional `rag` module behind try/except ImportError -- kept as an optional-feature placeholder, not cleaned. durable_exec/temporal is the opt-in `[temporal]` backend (imports temporalio), reached lazily only when DurableConfig.backend='temporal'; the core degrades to JSONL when absent.
